rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Unnumbered trailing clause: "`## Next` is two plain sentences: what the next module does, what the student carries into it (Antti 2026-08-14)."
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm the clause prevents: a closer that teaches steals the slide it points at. Absent here — M6 is the terminal module of the AE101 core arc, so there is no next module's beat to front-run, and the clause's own text says content ordinals/count strictness is for a section literally headed `## Next` that transitions INTO another module. Chunk 8 (lines 72-83) runs to 5 sentences plus a Going-deeper aside plus the capstone sign-off rather than 2, but the BANS the clause actually enforces are all clean: no mechanism aside in parentheses, no housekeeping (nothing about closing the session or reopening fresh), no term a later module coins. Cross-corpus check: `earn-the-trust.md`'s `## Next` also runs 3 sentences plus an optional supplementary pointer, so strict 2-sentence counting is not how the rest of the corpus reads this clause either — the operative test is content-type, not a literal count. The capstone sign-off ("Keep on learning and sharing." / "Antti") is separately authorized by the maintainer accept-note at line 91 (exception to `check_writing.md` §6).
